purpose: Which telemetry families a Compose Copter actually sends, before and after adding NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT (62) to bridge.DefaultRates.
method: curl -sN http://localhost:8080/api/events, counted by payload key.

with_nav_request.note: DefaultRates with {MsgID: 62, Hz: 1}. Backend restarted immediately before.

findings: NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT: 0 unasked, ~1 Hz once requested. The rate request is what makes the guidance readouts reachable.

HOME_POSITION: exactly 1 in 45 s on the baseline and 0 in the 40 s after a backend restart. It is an event emitted when home is set, not a stream, which is why it is declined in DefaultRates and aged against HOME_TTL_MS instead.

HOME_POSITION may never arrive at all if the backend restarts after the vehicle set home. The display shows it as unavailable, which is correct; recovering it would need MAV_CMD_GET_HOME_POSITION, an outbound command and therefore out of this read-only card.
RADIO_STATUS: 0, as expected. Compose carries MAVLink over UDP with no SiK modem in the path.
